services.story: The main story: a 60-minute reiki session at Alex's home with Owen, $140. A card is saved for the $70 fee, and Rosie texts the bill after the visit.

services.name: 60-min reiki at home (3-session pack)
services.story: A 3-session pack at home, $330, paid in full when booking. Each session uses one, and a no-show can use one up, if Sam confirms.

services_shape: one-to-one sessions of 60 minutes, with a practitioner the client picks or any free one; distance sessions by video or phone; packs of sessions; a home visit
questions_before_times: the kind of session (at the studio, at home, or by video or phone)
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
at home: what kind of place (a home or an office) and the town, before any times
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, sudden weakness or numbness, or a seizure
a new lump, bleeding that won't stop, or a symptom a doctor hasn't checked
license: none checked by Rosie: reiki has no state license in most places; a certificate or training is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
staff_skills: reiki levels I and II, hands-on and distance sessions, crystal add-ons; only practitioners with the level a booking names are offered
messages_never: health answers, pregnancy, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
